statement: The five nonsingular rational conics represented by the 5-by-6 coefficient matrix in Figure 2 admit 3264 distinct real tangent conics. The authors compute approximate solutions and use alphaCertified to prove that the associated solutions are distinct and real. Thus this explicit instance attains the full complex count, not merely a numerically observed real count.
